reviews.lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.user_impact: The critical path now has credible enlarged-text and semantic evidence, but rotor behavior, announcement pacing, gesture cost, and real-user comprehension remain unobserved.
findings.recommendation: Run a manual VoiceOver traversal on hardware with one target assistive-technology user or trained evaluator.
findings.verification: Source and uncertainty are announced before submit, exact contact fields before the Apple gate, cancellation before retry, and selected relationship plus the full unsent objective before Send, with no duplicate focus or trap.

findings.observation: The AX5 cancellation path is truthful and recoverable, but Contacts save, denial, duplicate, background, termination, and reconciliation states remain outside the executable bundle.
findings.evidence: ax5-apple-contact-editor.png and ax5-contact-cancelled.png prove exact-field review followed by no-write cancellation; artifact-manifest.json lists the other external and lifecycle outcomes as unavailable.
findings.user_impact: The accessible cancel path does not yet prove truthful behavior when permissions or process lifecycle change around the external write boundary.
findings.recommendation: Run the applicable Contacts and interruption rows from the mobile test matrix on a small and large supported iPhone.
findings.verification: Every row yields one truthful state, no duplicate contact, no false success, no lost reviewed relationship, and one editable unsent Session draft.

findings.criterion: Evidence comparison under realistic OCR error
findings.observation: The source remains zoomable and precedes editable evidence at AX5, but no plausible wrong name or date is seeded in this run.
findings.evidence: ax5-source-inspection.png and accessibility-runtime.json prove source open, zoom, close, and review order; artifact-manifest.json lists seeded OCR correction as unavailable.
findings.user_impact: A subtle OCR mismatch may survive if modal comparison becomes cognitively expensive at enlarged text.
findings.recommendation: Add a low-contrast synthetic fixture with one known mismatch and preserve draft plus reading position while comparing and correcting it.
findings.verification: At AX5, the mismatch is found and corrected, the original remains inspectable, and persisted evidence contains reviewed rather than raw OCR text.

reviews.lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action

findings.evidence: ax5-apple-contact-editor.png shows only reviewed synthetic fields; ax5-contact-cancelled.png and the passing journey prove discard without a claimed write; artifact-manifest.json lists the other outcomes as unavailable.
findings.user_impact: The product cannot yet guarantee one correct contact or reconstruct an external result after permission or lifecycle changes.
findings.recommendation: Test saved, denied, duplicate, interrupted, and reconciled synthetic outcomes while keeping unrelated Contacts unread.
findings.verification: Readback observes exactly one synthetic contact after save, none after cancel or denial, and a minimal receipt that never guesses an external result.

findings.observation: The delta preserves local screenshot ownership and synthetic-only Claude admission, but backup exclusion, retention aging, derived-store deletion, and private provider approval remain unverified.
findings.evidence: The r7 base artifact proves Complete File Protection, local Vision OCR, four bounded Agent tools, and synthetic-only Claude admission; r18 changes no provider or retention behavior and carries these gaps forward.
findings.user_impact: Private conversation evidence must remain blocked from Claude and deletion claims narrow until raw-and-derived lifecycle controls are observable.
findings.recommendation: Keep private evidence local, define backup and retention policy, exercise full deletion, then complete provider admission before widening scope.
findings.verification: No raw or derived capture data remains after the disclosed deletion boundary, and provider controls document purpose, training, retention, region, access, deletion, and incidents.

findings.observation: AX5 preserves source-before-action order and visible unknown attribution, but no forwarded, quoted, group-chat, or seeded OCR-error fixture proves redaction and correction before persistence.

findings.user_impact: Unrelated personal data or a plausible OCR error could enter a Person Wiki if the recruiter does not notice it.
findings.recommendation: Add synthetic forwarded, quoted, and group-chat fixtures plus one seeded wrong name or date.
findings.verification: No unrelated data persists, no third-party words are attributed to the Person, and the fragment retains reviewed text plus source and review provenance.
